title: Doc-freshness backlog: re-audit + re-pin the routed .design docs the doc-drift gate reports DRIFTED (bootstrap, decision 4); CI step lands with the commit clearing the last item (REQ-10 sequencing)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Bootstrap backlog (gate run at dff9ae86): 36/49 routed docs DRIFT, 81 doc-file pairs. Heaviest: basis/09-option-result (13 files), lower/boundary-composition (lower.rs +46), scaffold/workspace (5 files incl. forge/main.rs +23), forge/cli.md (cli.rs +21, internally split Summary-vs-REQ-table), basis/11-ergonomics (12 files), skill/skill-generator (drifted by #257 itself). Full list: run 'make doc-drift' or 'python3 tooling/doc-drift.py'. Work-off per the doc's re-pin workflow: review intervening commits, re-pin if accurate / dispatch acto-doc-author amendment if not. CI step (REQ-10 sequencing) lands in the commit that clears the last item.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Plan: 7 parallel doc-author re-audits over the 36 drifted docs (cli.md full re-author; per-area batches re-verifying every quoted-code claim against the current tree — amend where false, re-pin where true); orchestrator re-pins proof-backends.md after reviewing its single #263 intervening commit; the clearing commit lands the REQ-10 CI step (doc-drift gate + its fixture suite, full-history checkout).

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Result: BACKLOG CLEARED + CI ACTIVE (commit 2808c8a3). 36 docs re-audited by 7 parallel doc-author dispatches: ~29 amended (the dominant rot pattern: greenfield-era Summaries + NOT-STARTED rows contradicting the docs' own SHIPPED tables — e2e-vs-boundary flipped 6/6, provenance 6 rows, spectherm REQ-6, exec-stmt-tv REQ-4; plus dead cites, wrong signatures, stale counts), 7 clean re-pins with re-verified evidence, cli.md fully re-authored. proof-backends.md re-pinned post-#263 review; self-verification.md header corrected against epic #60's closing record. Gate: 49/49 CURRENT, exit 0; make doc-drift exit 0; fixture suite 13/13 OK. CI: doc-drift step + fixture-suite step landed in the clearing commit with fetch-depth:0 (the commit-set predicate needs full history). From this commit forward, touching a routed file without re-pinning/amending its design doc fails CI.
